The 26th WhatsOnStage Awards took place on 8 March 2026 at The London Palladium for the third time..
Winners and nominees
Nominations opened on 6 November 2025. The nominees for the 25th WhatsOnStage Awards were announced in December 2025 by Into the Woods stars Gracie McGonigal, Hana Ichijo and Gabrielle Lewis-Dodson at the Bridge Theatre in London. The winners were then revealed at a ceremony at The London Palladium
